help.<root>: Usage: cli-app [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... CUE Provider Utility: CLI for uploading files and folders to CUE. Options: --version Show the version and exit. -t, --token TEXT Authentication API key. Overrides all other sources. --env [prod|uat|sit|local] Target backend environment. Overrides default_env in config. --config FILE Path to a custom configuration file. Default: ~/.cue-upload/config.toml --log-file PATH Path to a custom log file or directory. Default: ~/.cue-upload/logs -v, --verbose Increase console output verbosity (-v for INFO, -vv for DEBUG with full network logs). -q, --quiet Minimal console output, showing only critical errors or final summaries. -h, --help Show this message and exit. Commands: upload Uploads files or directories to CUE. retry Retries all failed upload entries saved in the failed uploads log file. auth Manages upload keys per environment (OS keyring). configure Interactively configures CUE Provider Utility settings. ignore Manages ignored file patterns for folder uploads. logs Views application logs directly in the terminal. Examples: cue-upload upload -P ./data -c my_collection cue-upload retry cue-upload configure

Overrides all other sources. -f, --failed-log PATH Path to a custom failed uploads log file. --entry-id TEXT Retry only this failed-upload entry (repeatable). help.upload: Usage: cli-app upload [OPTIONS] Uploads files or directories to CUE. Options: -q, --quiet Minimal console output. -v, --verbose Increase console output verbosity. --log-file PATH Path to a custom log file or directory. --config FILE Path to a custom configuration file. --env [prod|uat|sit|local] Target backend environment. Overrides default_env in config. -t, --token TEXT Authentication API key. Overrides all other sources. -P, --path PATH Local file or directory path to be uploaded (repeat for several). -c, --collection TEXT Name of the target collection in the backend system. [required] -tp, --target-path TEXT User-defined sub-path within the collection for organization. -fc, --file-concurrency INTEGER RANGE Max number of files to upload concurrently (folder uploads). [x>=1] -pc, --part-concurrency INTEGER RANGE Max concurrent parts for a single multipart file. [x>=1] -y, --auto-approve Skip confirmation prompt for folder uploads. -h, --help Show this message and exit.
